botcomponent.description: Sends messages to a model deployment in Microsoft Foundry, through Azure API Management, and returns the completion. Deployments: patient-summary (Mistral-Large-3) writes patient-facing discharge instructions; prior-auth (gpt-5.5) writes prior authorization packets. Use it only as the patient-discharge-summary and prior-auth-packet skills direct.
botcomponent.name: Foundry chat completion
